method: Same three text inputs, real robot agent/Manager/Piper. STT bypassed. API and history/background work vary; live deltas are observational, not isolated causal speedup. TTS measured until PLAYING status, not physical sound.

source_versions.note: Only the Agent change was cherry-picked onto main. Baseline Agent source equals MR base Agent source; candidate runtime modules are byte-identical to deployed modules.

definitions.agent_s: SpeechTranscript publication to final SpeechRequest observation by one ROS probe.
definitions.provider_call_s: Persisted provider latency including adapter work/network/retries; not pure model inference.
definitions.agent_other_s: agent_s minus provider_call_s; derived residual, not direct function profiling.
definitions.tts_s: Final SpeechRequest observation to first PLAYING status; includes Manager, transport and synthesis.
definitions.text_to_playing_s: SpeechTranscript publication to first PLAYING status; not physical speaker onset.
definitions.guard_sql_count: SQLite trace callback statement count, including transaction statements.

limitations: STT bypassed and not measured; this is a text-boundary real robot test.
Three sequential baseline trials then three candidate trials, not randomized. Provider, history, background work and load can vary.
Two candidate setup attempts with no Agent acceptance, inference or playback were excluded; discovery was fixed before the three completed trials.
Live deltas combine query changes and delivery ordering; they do not isolate either optimization.
Guard benchmark reused the same cloned SQLite snapshot: nine recorded bindings repeated three times per setting. Valid cases stayed valid; invalidation safety is checked by regression tests.
Guard sample IDs are anonymous and consistent across conditions. Original conversations and database snapshots are not included.
